description:
Functional specification and files:
- After the connector-owned stopping lifecycle works, remove lib/zaq/node_router/coordination.ex and lib/zaq/node_router/async_handoff.ex.
- Remove coordination dispatch options, ownership propagation/holds, coordination-specific wrappers/checks and handoff acknowledgements from lib/zaq/node_router.ex and all consumers. Inventory current references before editing, including Channels.Api, ConnectorRuntime, ConnectorLifecycle and BO dispatches.
- Keep NodeRouter as event transport with its ordinary local/remote, synchronous/asynchronous dispatch behavior, error reporting, confidentiality and authorization boundaries. Removing AsyncHandoff does not mean removing ordinary asynchronous dispatch.
- Replace connector consumers with the lifecycle owner from the prerequisite. Remove obsolete configuration, application children or support code only when exclusively required by the deleted machinery.
- Do not leave orphan calls to coordinated?, coordination resource options or AsyncHandoff, and do not rebuild generic coordination under another name.

Tests to add before implementation: use the new stopping-state regression and existing ordinary NodeRouter contract tests as protection. Add narrowly scoped local/remote and ordinary async regression cases only if existing coverage misses an affected behavior. Dedicated coordination tests are removed in the next task; inventory the expected transitional failures without weakening unrelated tests.

Branches/paths validated: ordinary sync/async local dispatch, remote dispatch and RPC error handling, routing options, connector startup/teardown under the new owner, actor/confidentiality checks.

Mocking plan: reuse existing NodeRouter contract seams or peer-node integration support for routing behavior. Keep connector lifecycle integration real; no mocks of the new controller.

Documentation: remove obsolete router coordination/async ownership documentation in module docs and docs/architecture.md; update connector references to their domain owner. Read docs/documentation.md before edits.

Action reuse assessment: simplify existing NodeRouter dispatch infrastructure; no new operation, Action or agent tool. Reuse established service dispatch and the prerequisite connector lifecycle API. Preserve dispatch input/output/error semantics except the explicitly removed coordination feature.

Approval: user explicitly requested removal of NodeRouter coordination and both coordination/async_handoff modules in this conversation. Follow-up to closed zaq-nuz, whose earlier change removed only public wrappers and retained coordination.

Validation: reference audit, focused ordinary routing and connector lifecycle tests, mix q; record coordination-only test failures until the dependent removal task completes.

comments.text: Removed lib/zaq/node_router/coordination.ex and async_handoff.ex, coordinated receiver execution, scope capture/options and handoff logic. No production lib/config references remain. Ordinary NodeRouter suites pass: 43 tests/properties; mix q passes. Updated architecture and Engine/Channels lifecycle ownership documentation while preserving unrelated edits. Coordination-only test/support cleanup follows in zaq-mvw.3.

title: [zaq-mvw.2] Remove NodeRouter coordination and AsyncHandoff machinery
